description: Find a licensed photo for a post: searches Wikimedia Commons and returns each result with a small thumbnail you can see, plus title, author, license, license_url, attribution_required, a ready credit line, size, the file page and image_url (put image_url in the template's image variable). The license comes from Commons itself: never use a result whose license is null, and credit the author (credit) when attribution_required is true. Look at the thumbnails, open the best one at full size with viralhunt_fetch_image, then build the post. Read only; spends no daily query.

query.description: What the photo should show, in plain words (a place, a person, an object). English names find more.

name: viralhunt_search_images
